# Pesher Habakkuk Column 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** Well preserved; contains Day of Atonement passage

---

**11:1** "Woe to-him-who gains evil profit for-his-house,

**11:2** to-set his-nest on-high,

**11:3** to-be-delivered from-the-power-of evil!" (Hab 2:9)

**11:4** Its pesher concerns the-priest who [...]

**11:5** so-that the-sentence against-him would-be the-judgment-of-fire.

**11:6** "You-have-devised shame for-your-house

**11:7** by-cutting-off many peoples, and-you-sin

**11:8** against-your-own soul.

**11:9** For the-stone will-cry-out from-the-wall,

**11:10** and-the-beam from-the-woodwork

**11:11** will-answer-it" (Hab 2:10-11).

**11:12** [Its pesher] concerns the-Wicked-Priest,

**11:13** who pursued the-Teacher-of-Righteousness to-his house-of-exile,

**11:14** to-swallow-him-up in-his-fierce anger.

**11:15** And-at-the-time-of the-festival-of-rest, the-Day-of-Atonement,

**11:16** he-appeared before-them to-swallow-them-up

**11:17** and-to-trip-them on-the-day-of-fasting, their-sabbath-of-rest.

---
*EMET notes: Column 11 covers Hab 2:9-11. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
